source: The original paper demonstrated 3- and 4-bit weight quantization for very large GPT/OPT-style models and included custom low-bit kernels. Modern implementations add details such as group size, activation ordering, static groups, packing layout, and backend-specific kernels.
zh: 原始论文演示了非常大的 GPT/OPT 类型模型的 3 位和 4 位权重量化，并包含自定义的低位内核。现代实现添加了详细信息，例如组大小、激活顺序、静态组、打包布局和后端特定内核。
